messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: `svc-inference-eu` fired (high latency). Trigger: p95 > 6s for 5m, error-rate spike. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-98234

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-98234 assigned to on-call: Jules. Auto-escalation window = 6m.

Jules: acked. I'm taking initial triage — jumping on bridge now.

Kai: thx. I'm nearby, can help with routing and model fallback if needed.

Jules: quick status: P95 on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 jumped from ~2.3s to ~8s over last 10m. Errors (502/524) up ~12%. Looks like KV cache misses + queuing.

Amir: on standby to take handoff in ~8–10m. If we need capacity, I can add dedicated nodes.

Sasha: starting quick mitigation — enabling prefix caching warm-up and bumping batch timeout. Command: `infra runbook apply inference-eu-mitigation-v1`

Jules: good. Also switching small % of traffic to fallback-model-v2 to reduce pressure. Kai, can you set 25% traffic shift to fallback for non-enterprise routes?

Kai: doing it now: `route update --region eu --target fallback-model-v2 --pct 25 --notes "auto-mitigation"`

Kai: confirmed — 25% shifted. Monitoring.

Sasha: scaled dedicated pool +3 replicas: `infra scale --region eu --pool inference-dedicated --delta +3` — replicas now 12 (was 9).

Jules: running quick health checks:
```
curl -s 'https://metrics.internal/api/series?m=service.latency.p95&region=eu' | jq '.value'
# 8000
```

Jules: initial mitigations in place. Waiting 2–3 min to see effect. Noticed increased GC churn on gpu-nodes-07 in logs:

```
[2026-03-15T12:04:12Z] warn runtime: kv-cache miss spike=0.42; queue_len=18; alloc=7.2G
```

Amir: I can take this after the first stabilizing pass. Planning to run a rolling restart on nodes with GC issues if they stay noisy.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder — auto-escalation in 3m if not acknowledged by secondary.

Jules: status update (T+6m): p95 -> 4.1s, errors -> 6%. Improvements but still above SLO.

Kai: re-routed additional non-critical batch jobs off inference pool to free GPU cycles.

Sasha: applied a temporary kv-cache size increase on the pool: `kvcachectl set --region eu --pool inference-dedicated --size 24G` — pushing config now.

Jules: good catch. Can we also lower the batching max_tokens to reduce tail latency?

Sasha: lowered `max_batch_tokens` from 4096 -> 3072 for eu pool.

Jules: post-change metrics (T+12m): p95 -> 2.9s, errors -> 3.8%. Almost back to normal.

pagerduty-bot: PD-98234 acknowledged by Jules; ownership being transferred to Amir in 5m for warm-handover.

Amir: taking over now. Jules — quick handoff notes:
- root cause: KV cache pressure + GC on a subset of nodes
- mitigations applied: +3 replicas, kvcache size bump, reduced batch size, 25% traffic fallback-model-v2
- immediate customer impact: increased latency and ~10% error spike for embedding-heavy customers in EU for ~20m window
- follow-ups: INF-4321 (persistent kv tuning); schedule rolling node restarts for gpu-nodes with GC noise

Jules: thx — leaving the bridge. Ping me if it regresses. :thumbsup:

Amir: on bridge. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/PD-98234

Kai: will watch routing and rollback if fallback causes regressions.

Amir: update (T+25m): p95 steady ~2.5s, errors ~2.1%. Customer impact reduced; dialing back fallback to 10% to reduce user-visible model differences.

Amir: creating follow-up ticket INF-4321 for kv-cache tuning + automated pre-warm on node add. Adding runbook notes and assigning to infra team.

Sasha: file pinned: https://confluence.redwood/ops/INC-PD-98234-mitigation-notes

Amir: closing PD-98234 in PagerDuty since mitigations are stable and postmortem work is tracked.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-98234 closed by Amir. Duration: 38m.

Amir: short summary for the postmortem channel: KV cache pressure + GC on a small subset of GPU nodes caused queuing & high p95. Temporary mitigations restored service; follow-up to implement persistent cache sizing and better pre-warm on scale-up. I'll write the postmortem and link INF-4321.

incident-bot: Creating follow-up task INF-4321 assigned to @infra-team. SLA note: customer-facing impact window ~00:20 with partial degradation; notifying Customer Success to surface affected customers.

Amir: thanks everyone — good coordination. Closing thread. :checkered_flag:"
